senses.gloss:
Śrauta-ṛṣi^1 or Śrautarṣi,^2 ‘descendant of Srutaṛṣi or
Śrutarṣi,’ is the patronymic of Devabhāga.
1) Aitareya Brāhmaṇa, vii. 1, 6.
2) Śatapatha Brāhmaṇa, ii. 4, 4, 5; Taittirīya Brāhmaṇa, iii. 10, 9, 11.

Śraumatya, ‘descendant of Śrumant,’ is the name of a
teacher in the Śatapatha Brāhmaṇa (x. 4, 5, 1).
